question: Can waiting for an observed recovery improve the same weekly loser-long and winner-short pair? Keep the pair selection, costs and sizing fixed.
selection: Freeze the pair on its original weekly clock using the previous seven days of spot returns with the original 24-hour embargo. During the first 48 hours watch only the ratio of the selected long spot price to the selected short spot price at synchronized hourly opens. Trigger on the first ratio strictly above the preceding 24 hourly ratios. Execute one hour after the trigger, then close at the original end of the week. Do not enter again or replace the pair. Unconfirmed weeks retain cash.
evaluation: Compare after fees, adverse execution, signed funding and the original hourly collateral test with the same pair entered at the weekly clock. Use the four already studied half years for diagnosis. Freeze before fetching the additional year from 20 November 2023 01 UTC to 18 November 2024 01 UTC with a cut on 20 May 2024. Evaluate the entire year if all six market archives are usable. Keep any missing-market periods visible. No replacement markets or tuning. Require both new half years to beat cash and the fixed-entry control after costs and reach 2% geometric weekly before qualification.
